### A Prayer for Raising Our Ebenezer’s of Memory and Thanks
Author: Scotty Smith
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/scotty-smith/a-prayer-for-raising-our-ebenezers-of-memory-and-thanks/
Passage: 1 Samuel 7:12
Points:
- An Ebenezer stands as a tangible marker of God's unmerited rescue and enduring mercy.
- God faithfully preserves and defends His people even when they face relentless spiritual warfare.
- Recalling past milestones proves that every lasting victory stems completely from divine grace.
- Because Jesus offered His life for wandering sinners, believers can trust Him to bring them home.

### Here I Raise My Ebenezer: The Inspiration for ‘Come Thou Fount’
Author: David Mathis
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/here-i-raise-my-ebenezer
Passage: 1 Samuel 7:12
Points:
- Samuel erected the stone of help to ensure Israel remembered God's deliverance at Mizpah.
- The monument did not signify that trials were over, but that God had helped thus far.
- Modern believers remain prone to wander and still face continual threats to faith.
- Christ’s sacrifice on the cross is the ultimate Ebenezer, guaranteeing final safety in Him.
